knowledge:
- key_parameters: countsData/fileName=Input count table or KisSplice fasta file path ;; conditions=Vector describing the experimental conditions for each sample; must contain at least two replicates per condition, and * can be used to exclude specific samples ;; pairedEnd=Boolean indicating if RNA-Seq libraries are paired-end (default FALSE) ;; k2rg=Boolean indicating if the input file is from KisSplice2refgenome (default FALSE) ;; counts=Integer (0, 1, or 2) matching the counts parameter used in KisSplice ;; exonicReads=Boolean indicating whether to include exonic reads in the analysis ;; keep/remove=Character vectors to filter specific splicing event types (e.g., ES, IR, altA, altD) when importing KisSplice2refgenome data ;; technicalReplicates=Boolean indicating if replicates are technical (uses Poisson model if TRUE, Negative Binomial if FALSE) ;; nbCore=Integer specifying the number of cores to use for parallel computation ;; pvalue=Numeric threshold (0 to 1) for adjusted p-values to output significant events in the final table (default 1) ;; filterLowCountsVariants=Minimum global count threshold to filter out low-expressed variants before testing (default 10) ;; flagLowCountsConditions=Count threshold below which an event is flagged as low-expressed in a condition (default 10) ;; adjPvalMax/dPSImin=Thresholds used in writeOutputKissDE to filter exported results ;; writePSI=Boolean to export the PSI/f table instead of the main results table
- alternatives: DESeq2 is mentioned as the basis for normalization and shares similar statistical hypotheses ;; DSS is used internally to estimate the overdispersion parameter phi for the Negative Binomial model
- when_to_use: Appropriate for differential analysis of alternative splicing events, single nucleotide variations (SNVs/SNPs), or indels quantified across two or more conditions with replicates
- pitfalls: All analyzed conditions must have replicates (at least 2 replicates per condition); otherwise, the package will throw an error ;; Mixing biological and technical replicates in the same analysis is strongly discouraged ;; If sample order in the condition vector does not match the column order in the count table, replicates will fail to cluster in quality control plots ;; Setting the pvalue threshold too low during the diffExpressedVariants run permanently discards non-significant events from the returned object, requiring a full re-run if a different threshold is needed later ;; The sign of DeltaPSI/Deltaf depends on alphabetical ordering of the conditions, as kissDE subtracts the condition that comes first alphabetically from the other

workflows.name: alternative_splicing_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially used alternative splicing events from KisSplice2refgenome annotated output.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert KisSplice2refgenome output to counts using kissplice2counts ;; 2. Define condition vector ;; 3. Perform quality control using qualityControl ;; 4. Run differential analysis using diffExpressedVariants ;; 5. Export results using writeOutputKissDE ;; 6. Explore results interactively using exploreResults
workflows.code:
fileInAS <- system.file("extdata", "output_k2rg_alt_splicing.txt", package = "kissDE")
myCounts_AS <- kissplice2counts(fileInAS, pairedEnd = TRUE, k2rg = TRUE, counts = 2, exonicReads = FALSE)
myConditions_AS <- c(rep("SKNSH", 2), rep("SKNSH-RA", 2))
qualityControl(myCounts_AS, myConditions_AS)
myResult_AS <- diffExpressedVariants(myCounts_AS, myConditions_AS)
writeOutputKissDE(myResult_AS, output = "results_table.tab")
writeOutputKissDE(myResult_AS, output = "psi_table.tab", writePSI = TRUE)
exploreResults(rdsFile = "results_table.tab.rds")

workflows.name: snv_snp_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially represented single nucleotide variations (SNVs/SNPs) from KisSplice fasta output.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert KisSplice fasta output to counts using kissplice2counts ;; 2. Define condition vector ;; 3. Perform quality control using qualityControl ;; 4. Run differential analysis using diffExpressedVariants ;; 5. Export results using writeOutputKissDE ;; 6. Explore results interactively using exploreResults
workflows.code:
fileInSNV <- system.file("extdata", "output_kissplice_SNV.fa", package = "kissDE")
myCounts_SNV <- kissplice2counts(fileInSNV, counts = 0, pairedEnd = TRUE)
myConditions_SNV <- c(rep("TSC", 2), rep("CEU", 2))
qualityControl(myCounts_SNV, myConditions_SNV)
myResult_SNV <- diffExpressedVariants(myCounts_SNV, myConditions_SNV)
writeOutputKissDE(myResult_SNV, output = "final_table_significants.tab", adjPvalMax = 0.05)
exploreResults(rdsFile = "final_table_significants.tab.rds")

workflows.name: custom_count_table_analysis
workflows.intent: Run differential analysis on a pre-formatted custom table of counts.
workflows.stages: 1. Load custom count table using read.table ;; 2. Define condition vector ;; 3. Perform quality control using qualityControl ;; 4. Run differential analysis using diffExpressedVariants ;; 5. Export results using writeOutputKissDE
workflows.code:
fpath1 <- system.file("extdata", "table_counts_alt_splicing.txt", package = "kissDE")
tableCounts <- read.table(fpath1, head = TRUE)
myConditions <- c(rep("condition_1", 2), rep("condition_2", 2))
qualityControl(tableCounts, myConditions)
myResults <- diffExpressedVariants(countsData = tableCounts, conditions = myConditions)
writeOutputKissDE(myResults, output = "kissDE_output.tab")
